target.surface: spec/book-1-truth.md §3.4 ATP accounting, and the exact atp_spent pinned per (term, budget) by tests/spec_conformance/vectors.json — together they decide whether a conforming implementation may reuse a result it has already paid for

need.blocked_operation: Publish an implementation that answers a repeated Sigma-Glyph check without paying for it twice, and still call it conforming.
need.current_behavior: Book I charges every agent for every materialization and the conformance vectors pin atp_spent exactly, so an implementation that reuses a normal form it already computed returns a different spend for the same (term, budget) and fails conformance. On the packet's fixture the divergence is total: 8 of 8 terms, e.g. 12 ATP against 1 and 15 against 5. Book I's text never mentions memoization; the prohibition is a side effect of pinning spend, not a decision recorded anywhere.
need.required_capability: A stated position on whether a conforming implementation may reuse a normal form it holds for a demanded hash — and, if it may, WHICH of two prices it owes, since they differ by one and answer different questions: size(nf) - 1 is the floor below which the memory bound size <= spent + 1 itself fails, while size(nf) is the floor below which a memo install stops obeying the per-row discipline every Book I action satisfies (dsize <= cost - 1). Two implementations that both memoize agree on atp_spent only if they charge the same thing. Not an implementation: a statement, and if the answer is yes, which of the two numbers.
need.local_workaround: The ALife substrate memoizes outside conformance: a Memo priced at size(nf), off by default, with every receipt recording that a memo was used and the SHA-256 of the oracle beside it. On its population this cuts ATP by 8.2% (composites that demand each other's roots) and 17.1% (a generational arm where children inherit parents' hashes), with the answer hash unchanged everywhere.
need.why_workaround_is_insufficient: The numbers it produces are not Sigma-Glyph numbers. An ATP figure from a memoizing run cannot be compared with a Book I figure, cited in a receipt a verifier will re-run, or replayed by any conforming implementation — which is the property the substrate wanted Book I for. Every downstream consumer that re-runs a budgeted check (warrant's ski@v1 re-runs compare hash AND budget) inherits the same split.

reproducer.expected: R1: the same hash evaluated twice costs the same both times (12/12, 15/15, 13/13, 16/16) — Book I never reuses a result. R2: a memo priced at size(nf) reaches every oracle answer for 97 ATP against 185 (52.4%) with worst size-(spent+1) exactly 0. R3: the memory bound under four prices for the same memo — size(nf): 0/8 violations; size(nf)-1: 0/8; size(nf)-2: 4/8; flat 1: 4/8, worst excess +9. The bound's floor is size(nf)-1; size(nf) is what additionally keeps the per-row discipline. R4: the memoizing run and the oracle report different atp_spent on 8 of 8 terms, which is the conformance collision.
reproducer.counterexample: If Book I already fixes that atp_spent is exactly determined and that reuse is therefore forbidden by design, this closes as an existing contract, and the substrate keeps its memo strictly outside conformance and says so in every receipt — no protocol change. If an owner-side reading finds any published ADR, profile or vector that prices reuse, this closes as already-supported. The request survives only if the answer is 'nobody decided', in which case the price is already derived from §3.4 and needs adopting, not inventing.

boundaries.data_minimization: The fixture carries eight SKI terms built from the genesis alphabet and nothing else. The ALife populations, their generational economy, the corpus and the experiment's own hypotheses are deliberately omitted; none of them is needed to reproduce the collision.
non_claims: Filing this request does not establish the source case's hypotheses. ALIFE-EXP-002's H1 and H3 both FAIL against their preregistered criteria and the packet does not depend on them.
Merging this packet records demand and routing only; it does not adopt a protocol change, a memo action, or any price.
The measured ATP figures describe the reference Python evaluator at the pinned target revision, not a property of the specification.
The substrate claims no standing in Sigma-Glyph governance and proposes no text.
